en.title: Load Balancing
en.description:
Assign m tasks in the given order to n resources so that each resource receives a non-empty contiguous range of tasks. Minimize the maximum total load over all resources.

See below for this site's input/output protocol; the source repository's solution is not executed.
en.input: The first line contains n m, and the next line contains m processing times. 1≤n≤m≤100000, 1≤burstTime[i]≤10000.
en.output: Output the minimum possible maximum resource load.
en.explanation: With positive tasks and m≥n, any feasible assignment into at most n segments can be subdivided into exactly n segments without increasing the maximum load.
